text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2967004444 — KV cache contbatch spike in `mistral-low` pool. p95 latency +150%, kv.evictions rate x6, contbatch queue depth rising. Pager triggered. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/ins/2967004444 — tagging oncall.
Emma (oncall): ack, on it. grabbing traces and shard maps.
Joel (sre): i'm seeing shard=7 with high eviction churn and prefix cardinality explosion. contbatch worker memory usage spiked around 20:11 UTC. which config rolled recently?
Ash (ml-infra): recent rollout changed `contbatch.target_batch_size` to `256` for the MQA path to improve throughput. That increases KV prefix pressure for cardinality-heavy prompts. also a small change to prefetch policy went live.
Emma (oncall): i'm going to throttle prefetch to reduce pressure: running `redwoodctl set kv.prefetch_rate --pool=mistral-low --rate=64` now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: command accepted, change applied. monitoring metrics (p95/evictions).
Miriam (prod-eng): can we hotfix the batch config to fall back to the legacy contbatch algorithm for the pool? risky but quicker than full rollback.
Joel (sre): preparing a canary deploy: `deploy canary contbatch-legacy --pool mistral-low --nodes 3`. will run after emma confirms stability from throttle.
Emma (oncall): p95 improved from +150% -> +60% after throttle. eviction rate still high on shard=7. running `kvctl evict --shard=7 --aggressive=false` to reclaim memory. logs: ```2026-03-15T20:12:03Z shard=7 evict prefix="/u/alpha/.." size=1.2GB evictions=1200```.
Ash (ml-infra): looking at key patterns — large variance in prefix length from a small traffic cohort (Qwen-style dynamic prompts). seems the MQA prefetch policy misclassified those keys as low-cost.
Anil (customer-success): checked CS queue — BetaCorp ran a large scale A/B generation yesterday on Mistral-7b variant (integration id bcorp-2026-03-14). asked them to pause experiments and confirm payloads.
Joel (sre): staging fallback policy: route a fraction of new requests to `mistral-4b-fallback` until hotfix confirmed. command: `router set policy --pool=mistral-low --fallback=mistral-4b --pct=25`.
Emma (oncall): fallback applied, incoming to mistral-4b ~22%. p50 stable, p95 trending down. shard eviction curve flattening.
paging-bot: :white_check_mark: Paging acknowledged by Emma (oncall). Incident severity set to SEV2. Notifying SRE rotation and exec watch.
Miriam (prod-eng): need to prepare customer-facing note. Anil please draft brief impact notice: window, affected models/pools, mitigation steps, and ask customers to pause heavy prefix-var tests.
Anil (customer-success): draft pasted below for review:
```Hi BetaCorp / impacted users,
We're investigating increased latency and evictions in the `mistral-low` inference pool affecting some generation workloads (MQA/GQA paths). We've applied throttling and fallback routing; most traffic is stable. Please pause large-scale experiments until we confirm complete resolution. We'll follow up with a timeline and postmortem. — Redwood Inference Ops````
Emma (oncall): sign off. send to BetaCorp via CS and monitoring channel.
Joel (sre): canary contbatch-legacy deploy started, nodes=3. will watch for regressions in throughput and tail-latency.
incident-bot: canary deploy succeeded on 3 nodes; no regression detected for 5m.
Emma (oncall): eviction rate down ~70% vs peak, p95 close to baseline. moving to steady mitigation. documenting commands and timelines in runbook. handing off to next oncall.
Miriam (prod-eng): assign postmortem to Ash (ml-infra) + Joel (sre). Follow-ups:
- root cause: why `contbatch.target_batch_size=256` landed for MQA path without perf simulation for high-cardinality prefixes
- add guardrail: disallow batch_size >128 on pooled MQA routes unless flagged
- improve telemetry: detect sudden prefix-cardinality skew and auto-throttle prefetch
- customer communication & SLA check
Anil (customer-success): BetaCorp acknowledged and paused tests. they requested ETA for full resolution.
Emma (oncall): leaving detailed handoff notes: mitigation steps applied, commands executed, metrics links, customer notified. Next oncall: Lucy. @Lucy you're up — watch shard=7 for 2 hours and confirm p95 < 1.5x baseline before closing thread.
Lucy (next-oncall): ack and taking over. thanks team. :thumbsup:
